# Maverick City Builders (MCB)

> General contractor based at 1171 Main St, Lancaster, Massachusetts 01523, serving Worcester County and Central Massachusetts. Kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling, home additions, deck building, carpentry and built-ins, interior and exterior painting, general renovations, building restoration and water damage restoration. Owner: Douglas Mourao. Phone: (508) 656-7436. Email: douglas@mcitybuilders.com. Every job starts with a written estimate that itemizes scope, materials and exclusions, then a written contract before work begins.
